help:metadata.help:title: FastChess alpha 1.8.2: Complete Tournament, Engine, and Recovery Help
help:metadata.help:abstract: FastChess runs concurrent UCI tournaments, assigns EPD/PGN openings, maintains clocks and rules, adjudicates games, reports Elo and SPRT statistics, writes PGN/final EPD, logs protocol traffic, and saves JSON state. This manual documents the exact local Windows build plus behavior-matching source, including parser boundaries, hidden aliases, scheduling, option validation, output ordering, recovery, and persistence omissions.
help:metadata.help:document-status: Verified against the executable, behavior-matching source, parser probes, and controlled tournaments.

help:local-artifact.help:capability: This executable rejects compressed logs and .gz books.

help:upstream-source.help:explanation: The binary exhibits the hardened post-v1.8.2 parser. Its 260810 suffix is the compile-date fallback used when Git metadata is absent, so it cannot identify an exact commit; the cited snapshot matches its observed interface and behavior.

help:verification-notes.help:note: All four version spellings and both help spellings were probed; -h is rejected.

A two-game, concurrency-two tournament using the upstream dummy UCI engine produced color-reversed results, PGN, final EPD, JSON state, and a trace protocol log; observed go clocks began at base plus increment.
A compressed-log probe failed with the explicit no-zlib diagnostic, establishing the local capability.

help:semantic-model.help:title: Semantic organization
help:semantic-model.help:description: The hierarchy is readable prose; IDs, typed parameters, defaults, constraints, workflows, troubleshooting, evidence links, and relationship edges also form a machine-navigable knowledge graph.
help:semantic-model.help:authority: Observed executable behavior and matching source outrank abbreviated man-page wording.

help:topic.help:title: Quick start: paired, reproducible match
help:topic.help:command: .\fastchess.exe ` -engine "cmd=C:\Engines\EngineA.exe" name=EngineA ` -engine "cmd=C:\Engines\EngineB.exe" name=EngineB ` -each tc=10+0.1 option.Threads=1 option.Hash=64 ` -openings file=openings.epd format=epd order=random start=1 ` -srand 20260810 -rounds 100 -repeat -concurrency 2 ` -resign movecount=3 score=600 -draw movenumber=34 movecount=8 score=20 ` -pgnout file=match.pgn append=false notation=san ` -config outname=match-state.json
help:topic.help:result: One hundred openings, both colors per opening, at most two simultaneous games, fresh PGN, and resumable JSON.

help:caveats.help:item: Use an opening suite; otherwise all games use startpos.
PGN/EPD/log append by default; select append deliberately.
Concurrency multiplies engine processes, Threads, and Hash.
This local build has no zlib support.

help:rules.help:rule: Canonical tournament options use one hyphen; only listed help/version aliases and --compliance use two.
An option consumes following tokens until a hyphen-led token; a hyphen followed by a digit is consumed as a negative number.
Key/value groups require nonempty key=value tokens. Only -pgnout and -epdout allow no tokens.
Spellings, keys, enum values, and UCI option names are case-sensitive; -testEnv has a capital E.
Quote each token containing spaces. Separately supplied -event/-site words are concatenated without spaces.
-each is deferred until all immediate options—including -config—finish; repeated -each parameters accumulate.
Numbers reject whitespace, trailing junk, non-finite floats, and overflow. Close misspellings may receive suggestions.

help:stages.help:stage: Parse immediate options in order; loaded JSON replaces earlier accumulated state.
Apply deferred -each to every final engine.
Normalize/validate schedule, concurrency, statistics, engines, names, and limits.
Open logging, seed RNG, initialize Syzygy, book, files, output, affinity, and saved stats.
Generate pairings lazily and enqueue up to concurrency jobs.
Start/borrow engines; UCI, options, Chess960, ucinewgame, and readiness.
position/go/bestmove, clocks, legality, natural rules, and adjudication.
Write artifacts, update results, print intervals, test SPRT, and request next game.
Periodic/final JSON replacement, worker shutdown, and engine quit.

help:topic.help:title: Topology, schedule size, openings, and colors

help:topology.help:description: Every unordered pair meets once per tournament round.
First S seeds meet later-index engines; seed pairs occur once and nonseeds do not meet.

help:topic.help:games-semantics: Supported games/encounter is one or two. If games exceeds two, sanitation first swaps games and rounds for legacy inverted configurations, then rejects if games still exceeds two. Use explicit -rounds R -games 2.
help:topic.help:color-policy: Global one-based even game IDs swap players unless -noswap; -reverse then swaps every game again. games=2 balances each encounter. games=1 alternates globally, not per pair.
help:topic.help:penta-policy: Pentanomial statistics group the two games by pairing ID despite concurrent completion; penta is disabled when games is not two or output is cutechess.

help:topic.help:title: Engine layering, validation, UCI, caching, and resources

help:subtopic.help:title: Layering
help:subtopic.help:description: Each -engine creates a record. Deferred -each scalar tokens overwrite per-engine fields regardless of placement; option.NAME tokens append. Names default to cmd stem; duplicates become NAME_2, NAME_3, because names key caches and scoreboards.

help:subtopic.help:title: Validation
help:subtopic.help:description: At least two engines; each needs tc, st, nodes, or plies/depth after layering. tc and st conflict; nodes/depth can accompany either. Windows appends .exe when cmd has no period. Absolute or dir-prefixed paths are prechecked; bare relative commands are not.

help:sequence.help:step: Start; uci; collect id/options through uciok.
Before every game send Threads first, other configured options, UCI_Chess960=true when needed, ucinewgame, isready.
Each move: isready, position, isready, go, bestmove, isready.
At disposal send stop/quit, then force-kill if needed.

help:subtopic.help:title: UCI option validation
help:subtopic.help:description: Exact advertised names and declared check/spin/combo/string/button values are validated. Invalid/unknown values warn and are skipped. Buttons accept only true and are sent without value; false is rejected in this build.

help:subtopic.help:title: Reuse/resources
help:subtopic.help:description: Engines are cached by configured name and leased exclusively. Parallel games can create multiple copies: budget about 2*concurrency processes and corresponding Threads/Hash. restart=on deletes that engine after each game.

help:topic.help:title: Clocks, search limits, margins, and deadlines

help:subtopic.help:description: Decimals and an s suffix on seconds components are accepted. Any hg is rejected. tc=inf/infinite supplies no limit and therefore needs nodes/depth.

help:subtopic.help:title: Accounting
help:subtopic.help:formula: bestmove threshold = current time left + timemargin + 100 ms

help:subtopic.help:title: Composition
help:subtopic.help:description: nodes and depth can both be emitted and may accompany clock/movetime. If either nodes or depth exists, bestmove has no wall-clock read timeout; a hung engine can block indefinitely even when a clock is also present.

help:topic.help:title: EPD/PGN books, shuffle, offsets, and assignment

help:subtopic.help:title: Readers
help:subtopic.help:description: EPD mode retains every nonempty line and parses it only when selected: a semicolon uses EPD parsing, otherwise FEN. Invalid selection is fatal. PGN creates one opening/game, honors FEN, parses SAN, retains up to plies, and excludes a source game-ending move; bad SAN leaves the successfully parsed prefix.
help:subtopic.help:note: Lowercase .epd/.pgn infer format. Other suffixes need format=. .gz requires zlib and is unavailable locally.

help:sequence.help:step: Rotate start-1 plus completed-games/games on resume.

help:subtopic.help:title: Assignment
help:subtopic.help:description: Fetch one opening per engine encounter and share it across games. With two engines/games=2 this is paired testing. With multiple engines, every pair advances the book; a nominal tournament round does not share one opening across all pairs.

help:subtopic.help:title: FRC
help:subtopic.help:description: fischerandom requires a book, uses Chess960 board parsing, sends UCI_Chess960=true when advertised, adds variant metadata, and suppresses orthodox ECO.

help:priority.help:item: At turn start: checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition, fifty-move rule.
After a legal move update trackers; apply next turn.

help:subtopic.help:title: Draw score
help:subtopic.help:description: Each centipawn report with abs(score)<=threshold increments a shared ply counter; mate/out-of-range/missing resets. halfmove clock zero also resets. Requires 2*movecount reports and fullMoveNumber-1>=movenumber. Scores are reporting-engine perspective.

help:subtopic.help:title: Resignation
help:subtopic.help:description: One-sided mode requires movecount losing reports for one color. twosided requires 2*movecount consecutive absolute decisive reports and fires when the latest reporting engine is losing. Negative mate scores qualify.

help:subtopic.help:title: Maximum moves
help:subtopic.help:description: -maxmoves N draws after 2*N engine-played plies, excluding PGN book moves and starting FEN counter. Use positive N; zero can draw immediately.

help:subtopic.help:title: Syzygy
help:subtopic.help:description: -tb enables WDL; tbpieces limits piece count (zero uses loaded availability); tbignore50 ignores rule 50; tbadjudicate filters WIN_LOSS/DRAW/BOTH. Tablebase precedes heuristic adjudication but follows natural endings.

help:subtopic.help:title: Reports
help:subtopic.help:description: Fastchess output gives logistic Elo, nElo, 95% errors, LOS, score/draw ratio, and optionally pentanomial counts. Tiny/degenerate samples can show NaN/infinity without a game failure. Cutechess output is WDL-oriented and disables penta.
help:subtopic.help:note: ratinginterval counts pairs in penta mode, games otherwise; scoreinterval affects cute output. Zero disables periodic output.

help:subtopic.help:title: SPRT
help:subtopic.help:description: Boundaries are log(beta/(1-alpha)) and log((1-beta)/alpha). normalized (default) uses nElo, logistic regular Elo, bayesian BayesElo and disables penta. H0 at/below lower; H1 at/above upper.
help:subtopic.help:validation: elo0<elo1; 0<alpha,beta<1; alpha+beta<1; model exact. Use exactly two engines though parser does not enforce it.
help:subtopic.help:concurrency-note: Boundary sets global stop; active games become interrupted rather than clean overshoot results.

help:topic.help:title: Console, PGN, final EPD, order, and CRC

help:subtopic.help:description: fastchess is the default rich report; cutechess emits compatibility game/score/Elo/SPRT lines and disables penta. Concurrent start/finish lines follow runtime order.

help:subtopic.help:title: PGN
help:subtopic.help:description: -pgnout alone creates a timestamped name. Core headers: Event, Site, Date, Round, White, Black, Result, conditional SetUp/FEN/Variant. Non-min adds engine IDs/authors, duration/times, PlyCount, Termination, time control, ECO/opening. Round is pairing ID+1, not necessarily nominal tournament round in multi-engine events.
help:subtopic.help:comments: Non-min comments always include reporting-engine score/depth/measured time; flags add nodes, seldepth, nps, hashfull, tbhits, PV, timeleft, latency, and regex-matched lines. Score signs are mover perspective, not White-normalized.
help:subtopic.help:minimal: min=true removes diagnostic headers/comments but keeps core/setup/variant/moves/result.

help:subtopic.help:title: Final EPD
help:subtopic.help:description: One final legal position per recorded game; stops before illegal move and includes hmvc/fmvn.

help:subtopic.help:title: Append/order
CRC32
help:subtopic.help:description: -crc32 pgn=true starts from existing bytes, updates each game, and prints cumulative checksum; it does not validate/deduplicate PGN.

help:topic.help:title: JSON state, resume, and engine-fault recovery

help:subtopic.help:title: Saving
help:subtopic.help:description: Replace config_name every positive autosaveinterval completed games and again at destruction. Zero/negative disables periodic only. JSON contains most tournament fields, engines, and pair stats; replacement is not an atomic temporary-file rename.

help:subtopic.help:title: Loading
help:subtopic.help:description: -config file immediately replaces configuration/engines/stats. Later immediate options override; deferred -each applies last. With two engines and stats=true, result count offsets schedule/book and forces artifact append. More than two engines causes loaded stats to be dropped.
help:subtopic.help:warning: Changing engine identities, games, book, or seed while retaining stats can corrupt experiment continuity.

help:subtopic.help:title: Not serialized
-recover differs from resume
help:subtopic.help:description: Without recover, stall/disconnect stops abnormally after state stats update but before that game's PGN/EPD write. With recover, the loss is written/counted, unhealthy engines restart, and scheduling continues. Startup failures still stop.

help:topic.help:title: Logging, compliance, strict mode, PVs, latency, and affinity

help:subtopic.help:title: Logging
help:subtopic.help:description: -log requires key=value; defaults append=true, level=warn, realtime=true, engine=false. engine=true records UCI; realtime=false batches search output until bestmove. Windows merges child stderr into stdout. compress=true fails locally (no zlib); a zlib build creates FILE+timestamp+.gz and ignores append.

help:subtopic.help:title: Compliance
help:subtopic.help:description: --compliance must be first, takes engine path and at most one argument string, then checks startup/readiness, id name/author, new game, startpos/FEN, timed go for colors/increments, bestmove, and integer info time/nps/score; info score is required.

help:subtopic.help:title: Strict/PV/latency
help:subtopic.help:description: -strict globally stops on runtime Logger warnings or worse. -check-mate-pvs checks legality, rule boundaries, mate length/end, and bestmove agreement. -show-latency prints measured minus engine-reported time and may be negative.

help:subtopic.help:title: Affinity
help:subtopic.help:description: -use-affinity discovers CPUs or parses a list such as 3,5,7-11, binds tournament thread before child spawn and also binds process. Use only with option.Threads=1 in this revision: the multi-thread-disable path is inconsistent and may bind a multi-thread engine to one CPU.

help:constraints.help:title: High-value constraints and interactions
help:constraints.help:rule: Every engine needs tc/st/nodes/depth after layering.
Use games=2 for colors and penta.
Use positive schedule counts, valid seeds, and nonnegative wait; signed-to-unsigned conversions can surprise.
Budget about 2*concurrency engine processes and multiplied Threads/Hash.
Existing, nonempty, valid book; explicit format unless lowercase suffix infers.
FRC requires Chess960 book and UCI_Chess960 engines.
Local binary cannot compress or read .gz.
Use exactly two engines and valid probability/Elo bounds.
Choose append deliberately; loaded stats force it.
Prevalidate match_line regex; invalid regex can strand schedule progress.
Use only with option.Threads=1 in this revision.
Use positive move counts and conservative thresholds.

help:workflow.help:command: .\fastchess.exe -engine cmd=A.exe name=A -engine cmd=B.exe name=B -each nodes=10000 -rounds 1 -repeat -log file=smoke.log level=trace engine=true append=false
help:workflow.help:success: Two games finish with reversed colors; log shows uci/uciok, options, new game, position, go, bestmove.

help:workflow.help:note: Preserve seed, start, book bytes, engine order, rounds, and games.

help:workflow.help:command: ... -sprt elo0=0 elo1=2 alpha=0.05 beta=0.05 model=normalized -report penta=true -rounds 100000 -repeat
help:workflow.help:note: Use paired openings and a large maximum; the boundary normally stops earlier.
Candidate meets both opponents; opponents do not meet.

help:workflow.help:command: ... -pgnout file=games.pgn append=false notation=san nodes=true seldepth=true nps=true hashfull=true tbhits=true pv=true timeleft=true latency=true -epdout file=final.epd append=false -crc32 pgn=true

help:workflow.help:note: First inspect loaded engine/book/output identity; re-specify omitted settings.
A fault remains a game loss; recovery restarts and proceeds.

help:workflow.help:step: Use Ordoprep if graph preparation is needed, then Ordo for ratings/uncertainties.

help:automation.help:title: Automation contract
help:automation.help:rule: Record executable/version/hash, full command, cwd, engine hashes, book hash, seed, and state filename.
Use absolute artifact paths or establish cwd; default PGN/EPD/config/log paths are relative.
Success means exit 0, expected completed count, and artifact checks; a parseable partial file is insufficient.
Capture stdout/stderr. Redirected Windows help may say “Failed to get console mode” yet exit 0.
Before resume, compare JSON engine/book/output identity and restore omitted options explicitly.
Do not copy JSON while FastChess may be replacing it unless the copy method is filesystem-consistent.

help:problem.help:resolution: Use -help or --help.

help:problem.help:cause: Previous option consumes until next hyphen-led option.
help:problem.help:resolution: Restore missing option and quote intended tokens.
Use exact catalog; only pgnout/epdout may be empty.
Add two -engine groups or load valid config.
Supply a limit to every engine.

help:problem.help:cause: Both rolling and fixed clocks set.
help:problem.help:resolution: Choose one; nodes/depth can remain.
Run --compliance and inspect trace engine log.

help:problem.help:cause: Name absent/case mismatch or value invalid for advertised type/range.
help:problem.help:resolution: Log engine traffic and copy advertised declaration.
Use option.NAME=true to press; omit otherwise.
Fix/supervise engine; adding tc does not restore deadline while nodes/depth remains.

help:problem.help:cause: Measured wall time exceeded clock+timemargin; info time is not authoritative.
help:problem.help:resolution: Reduce load/concurrency/logging, inspect latency, cautiously increase millisecond margin.
Reduce or knowingly force; budget processes/threads/hash.

help:problem.help:cause: games>2 triggers legacy swap then recheck.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use -rounds R -games 2 explicitly.
Use games=2 without noswap; reverse only to invert all.

help:problem.help:cause: No recognized suffix/format or no book; no-book emits a second format warning.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use file=... format=epd|pgn.

help:problem.help:cause: EPD lines parse only when selected.
help:problem.help:resolution: Validate every nonempty line beforehand.
Use uncompressed files or zlib build.
Two engines; e.g. elo0=0 elo1=2 alpha=0.05 beta=0.05 model=normalized.

help:problem.help:cause: games!=2, cute output, or bayesian model.
help:problem.help:resolution: Fast output, games=2, normalized/logistic—or accept WDL.
Verify games; wait for varied sample before interpreting rating.
level=trace engine=true, optionally realtime=false.
Fix warning or remove strict for exploration.

help:problem.symptom: no further schedule progress with match_line
help:problem.help:cause: Invalid std::regex throws inside game; interrupted game is not counted/replaced.
help:problem.help:resolution: Prevalidate regex in one-round smoke test.

help:problem.help:cause: Loaded stats force append to protect history.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use stats=false/discard=true only for intentional new history.
Re-specify after -config.
Preserve PGN; do not rely on stats resume for multi-engine event.

help:problem.symptom: fault result in state but absent PGN
help:problem.help:cause: Without recover, stop occurs before output write but after stats update.
help:problem.help:resolution: Use recover if fault losses should be written/continued; reconcile state and PGN.

help:problem.help:cause: Current affinity disable path is inconsistent.
help:problem.help:resolution: Affinity only with option.Threads=1, or omit it.

help:problem.help:cause: Writes serialize but are not reordered.
help:problem.help:resolution: Sort downstream by metadata if required.

help:term.help:name: encounter
help:term.help:definition: One engine pair, one opening, and games games.

help:term.help:name: pairing ID
help:term.help:definition: Internal encounter identity; PGN Round is ID+1.

help:term.help:name: pentanomial
help:term.help:definition: Two-game outcomes LL, LD, WL/DD, WD, WW.

help:term.help:name: nElo
help:term.help:definition: Normalized Elo scaled by observed variance.

help:term.help:name: LLR
help:term.help:definition: Log-likelihood ratio compared to SPRT bounds.

help:term.help:name: recover
help:term.help:definition: Continue after counting a fault loss; not JSON resume.

help:term.help:name: resume
help:term.help:definition: Load state/stats and continue from completed count.

help:term.help:name: EPD
help:term.help:definition: FEN-derived position plus optional semicolon operations.

help:term.help:name: UCI
help:term.help:definition: Universal Chess Interface, the sole engine protocol.
